title: Father Crouching with Crying Baby on Sunny Lawn, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white outdoor snapshot capturing a young father crouched on a grassy lawn, supporting a fussy infant on his knees. The father wears a neat side-parted haircut, a light-colored collared shirt, and slacks, looking down affectionately at the baby, who is dressed in a white one-piece garment. Deep shadows on the lawn suggest harsh midday sunlight, with dense shrubs forming the backdrop—an authentic glimpse into American domestic life and early parenting during the mid-1940s.
